description: This 2026 Chevrolet Equinox LT delivers the practical capability and refined comfort you expect from a modern SUV, designed to make every journey more convenient and enjoyable.  - Dual-zone automatic climate control - 8-way power driver seat adjuster - 2-way power driver lumbar control - Wireless phone charging for portable devices - Hands-free programmable power liftgate with AutoSense - Rain-sensing intermittent front wipers - Heated wiper park - 11.3" diagonal advanced color LCD display with Chevrolet Infotainment 3 - Navigation system - Universal home remote - SiriusXM with 360L trial subscription - Heated steering wheel - Heated driver and front passenger seats - 17" Grazen metallic machined-face aluminum wheels  The Equinox LT combines functionality with thoughtful design features that enhance your daily driving experience. Convenience features work seamlessly to simplify your routine. The universal home remote lets you control compatible home systems directly from your vehicle, while the sunglass holder keeps essentials organized and within reach.  Technology integration keeps you connected and informed. The 11.3-inch advanced color display partners with Chevrolet Infotainment 3 to provide intuitive control of navigation, audio, and vehicle functions. SiriusXM satellite radio offers a trial subscription to expand your entertainment options, and steering wheel mounted controls keep your attention on the road.  Safety and security features work continuously to protect you and your passengers. Four-wheel independent suspension delivers stability across varied terrain, while Electronic Stability Control and traction control enhance handling in challenging conditions. Comprehensive airbag protection, ABS brakes, and a low tire pressure warning system contribute to your peace of mind on every drive. The silver exterior finish maintains its appeal while the body-color heated power-adjustable mirrors, roof rack rails, and spoiler contribute to a cohesive, purposeful appearance. The power liftgate facilitates convenient cargo access, while the split-folding rear seat adapts to your load requirements.
